zh-Hans.name: 爪记 Zoji - 宠物健康记录与疫苗驱虫提醒
zh-Hans.subtitle: 养猫养狗日记，体重管理、病历整理与家人共同照护
zh-Hans.keywords: 猫咪,狗狗,养宠,多宠,档案,用药,体检,接种,就医,复诊,医院,记账,费用,相册,成长,生日,定时,待办,周期,同步,iCloud,家庭共享,铲屎官,记录本
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 猫咪狗狗的疫苗、驱虫和用药时间，交给爪记提醒。体重变化、病历照片与日常记录集中保存，还能邀请家人一起照顾多只宠物。无需注册账号，支持 iCloud 同步。
zh-Hans.whatsNew: 本次更新优化了 App Store 中的功能介绍和截图展示，帮助你更清楚地了解疫苗驱虫提醒、健康记录和家庭照护功能。

en-US.name: Zoji: Pet Health Tracker
en-US.subtitle: Care Reminders, Family Sharing
en-US.promotionalText: Keep pet care on track with vaccine, deworming and medication reminders. Save weight and vet records, and care together with family. No sign-up; optional iCloud sync.
en-US.whatsNew: Updated our App Store description and screenshot presentation to make pet care reminders, health records, and family sharing easier to discover.
